# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-config` from the configuration schemas. Do not edit by hand. -->

You do not need a configuration file: the hub is set up in its web UI, and an agent writes its own `agent.toml` when it enrolls. This page lists every setting for when you want to [manage configuration as code](../install/config-as-code.md), or to change an agent's checks.

Each table lists a section's keys. A key's description gives its default; a key without one is required when its section is present. Any scalar can also be set with an environment variable, `DOMOVOI_<SECTION>__<KEY>`, as described in [config as code](../install/config-as-code.md#environment-variables).

Value types:

- **duration**: a string such as `"30s"`, `"5m"`, `"24h"`, `"7d"` or `"1h30m"`.
- **time**: a local time of day, `"HH:MM"`.
- **time zone**: an IANA name such as `"Europe/Sofia"`.
- **secret**: never written inline: `{ env = "VARIABLE" }` reads an environment variable, `{ file = "/path" }` reads a file only its owner can read.

To check a file, run `domovoi check config <file>`.

## `hub.toml`

The whole of `hub.toml`. Every section is optional; omitted keys take the defaults documented on each field.

### `[agent_server]`

The listener agents connect to.

| Key | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bind` | string | Listen address for agent connections. Default `0.0.0.0:7421`. |
| `heartbeat` | duration | How often agents send a heartbeat. Three missed heartbeats mean a silent agent. Default `10s`. |
| `public_url` | URL | The `wss://` address agents dial, as printed in the enroll command. Default `wss://<hub name>:<bind port>`. |
| `self_check` | string | A `host:port` outside the network the hub checks before it blames a silent host. Default `1.1.1.1:53`. |

### `[backup]`

Local database backups.

| Key | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dir` | string | Where backups are written. Default `<data_dir>/backups`. |
| `keep` | integer | Backups kept. Default 7. |

### `[discord]`

The Discord bot. Omit to run without Discord.

| Key | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `allowed_user_ids` | list of integer | Discord users who may press buttons and run commands. Required when enabled. |
| `bot_token` | secret | The bot token. |
| `channel_id` | integer | The channel incidents are posted to. |
| `enabled` | boolean | Whether the bot runs. Default `true`. |
| `webhook_url` | secret | A channel webhook used when the bot is down. Optional. |

### `[heartbeat]`

A dead man's switch pinged while the hub is healthy. Omit to disable.

| Key | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `interval` | duration | How often it is pinged. Default `"1m"`. |
| `url` | secret | The URL pinged; it often embeds a token, so it is a secret. |

### `[hub]`

Identity and storage of this hub.

| Key | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data_dir` | string | Where the database and state live. Default `/var/lib/domovoi`. |
| `name` | string | Display name of this hub. Default `"domovoi"`. |
| `timezone` | time zone | Time zone for quiet hours, digests and day boundaries. Default `"UTC"`. |

### `[incidents]`

How signals become incidents.

| Key | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `confirm_runs` | integer | Consecutive failing runs before an incident opens. Default 2. |
| `default_ttl` | duration | Incidents with no new signal for this long resolve. Optional. |
| `grouping_window` | duration | Signals on one host this close together are grouped. Default `"5m"`. |
| `reopen_window` | duration | A resolved incident that fails again within this window reopens. Default `"6h"`. |

### `[llm]`

Language model providers used by triage.

#### `[llm.primary]`

The provider tried first. Required when triage is enabled.

| Key | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `api_key` | secret | API key. Required for `anthropic`. |
| `base_url` | URL | API base URL. Required for `openai_compatible`; optional for `anthropic`. |
| `kind` | `"anthropic"` or `"openai_compatible"` or `"cli"` | Which adapter talks to the model. |
| `model` | string | Model name. Required for `anthropic` and `openai_compatible`. |

##### `[llm.primary.cli]`

How to run a local CLI. Required for `cli`.

| Key | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `args` | list of string | Arguments that replace the preset's own when not empty. Check them against the installed CLI's `--help`. |
| `command` | string | Absolute path of the program to run instead of a preset's default. |
| `preset` | `"claude"` or `"codex"` | A known tool whose arguments Domovoi supplies. Set this or `command`. |

##### `[llm.primary.price]`

Prices used for the monthly budget. Optional.

| Key | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `input_per_mtok_usd` | number | Dollars per million input tokens. |
| `output_per_mtok_usd` | number | Dollars per million output tokens. |

#### `[llm.secondary]`

A fallback used when the primary fails. Optional.

| Key | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `api_key` | secret | API key. Required for `anthropic`. |
| `base_url` | URL | API base URL. Required for `openai_compatible`; optional for `anthropic`. |
| `kind` | `"anthropic"` or `"openai_compatible"` or `"cli"` | Which adapter talks to the model. |
| `model` | string | Model name. Required for `anthropic` and `openai_compatible`. |

##### `[llm.secondary.cli]`

How to run a local CLI. Required for `cli`.

| Key | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `args` | list of string | Arguments that replace the preset's own when not empty. Check them against the installed CLI's `--help`. |
| `command` | string | Absolute path of the program to run instead of a preset's default. |
| `preset` | `"claude"` or `"codex"` | A known tool whose arguments Domovoi supplies. Set this or `command`. |

##### `[llm.secondary.price]`

Prices used for the monthly budget. Optional.

| Key | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `input_per_mtok_usd` | number | Dollars per million input tokens. |
| `output_per_mtok_usd` | number | Dollars per million output tokens. |

### `[notify]`

When people are notified.

#### `[notify.digest]`

The daily digest.

| Key | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | boolean | Whether the digest is sent. Default `true`. |
| `time` | time | Local time it is sent. Default `"09:00"`. |

#### `[notify.quiet_hours]`

Warnings wait until these hours end; critical alerts are always sent. Optional.

| Key | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `end` | time | When quiet hours end, such as `"09:00"`. |
| `start` | time | When quiet hours begin, such as `"00:00"`. |

#### `[notify.renotify]`

How often an unacknowledged incident is announced again.

| Key | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `critical` | duration | Interval for critical incidents. Default `"4h"`. |
| `warning` | duration | Interval for warnings. Default `"24h"`. |

### `[[probes]]`

Network probes run from the hub.

| Key | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `expect_status` | integer | The HTTP status that counts as healthy. Required for `http`. |
| `host` | string | The host the probe reports on. |
| `interval` | duration | How often it runs. Default `"1m"`. |
| `kind` | `"tcp"` or `"http"` | What the probe does. |
| `target` | string | `host:port` for `tcp`; an `http` or `https` URL for `http`. |

### `[secrets]`

Secret hygiene.

| Key | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `exposed` | list of string | Names of secrets you know were exposed; each raises an advisory until removed. |

### `[triage]`

Automatic triage of new incidents.

| Key | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cache_days` | integer | Days a triage report is reused for the same evidence. Default 7. |
| `concurrency` | integer | Triage runs at the same time. Default 2. |
| `enabled` | boolean | Whether new incidents are triaged automatically. Default `false`. |
| `monthly_budget_usd` | number | Spending cap per calendar month, in US dollars. Optional. |
| `per_hour_runs` | integer | Runs started per hour at most. Default 6. |

#### `[triage.per_run]`

Limits for a single run.

| Key | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `output_tokens` | integer | Output tokens per run. Default 2000. |
| `seconds` | integer | Wall-clock seconds per run. Default 90. |
| `tool_calls` | integer | Tool calls per run. Default 15. |

### `[web]`

The web UI and HTTP API listener.

| Key | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bind` | string | Listen address. Default `127.0.0.1:7420`. |
| `public_url` | URL | The URL people use to reach the UI, for links in chat. Optional. |
| `trusted_proxies` | list of IP address | Reverse proxies whose `X-Forwarded-For` is trusted. Default none. |

### `[webhooks.<name>]`

Inbound webhooks, keyed by the name used in their URL.

| Key | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `auth` | `"hmac"` or `"bearer"` | How requests prove they are genuine. |
| `default_host` | string | Host used when the payload names none. Optional. |
| `host_label` | string | For Alertmanager, the label that names the host. Default: `host`, then `instance` without its port. |
| `kind` | `"generic"` or `"alertmanager"` or `"uptime_kuma"` | The payload format. |
| `secret` | secret | The HMAC key or bearer token. |

## `agent.toml`

The whole of `agent.toml`. Only `[agent]` is required.

### `[agent]`

Identity of this agent and where it connects.

| Key | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `host_name` | string | This host's name as shown in Domovoi. |
| `host_root` | string | Where the host filesystem is mounted; `/host` when running in a container. Default `/`. |
| `hub_url` | URL | The hub's agent server, such as `wss://hub.example.net:7421`. Must use `wss`. |
| `skills_dir` | string | Where skill manifests are read from. Default `/etc/domovoi/skills`. |
| `state_dir` | string | Where the agent keeps its key and spool. Default `/var/lib/domovoi-agent`. |

### `[checks.<name>]`

Per-check settings, keyed by check key such as `disk.usage`.

| Key | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `criticality` | `"critical"` or `"warning"` | Overrides how bad a failure is. Default: decided by the check. |
| `enabled` | boolean | Whether the check runs. Default `true`. |
| `interval` | duration | How often it runs. Default: the check's own interval. |
| `thresholds` | map of string | Check-specific thresholds; each check documents its keys. |

### `[containers]`

Container baselines.

| Key | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `baseline_expiry` | duration | A container gone this long is dropped from the baseline. Default `"7d"`. |
| `critical` | list of string | Container names whose absence is critical. |
| `ignore` | list of string | Container names never checked. |

### `[docker]`

The Docker integration.

| Key | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | boolean | Whether container checks and skills are enabled. Default `false`. |
| `endpoint` | string | `unix:///path/to/docker.sock` or `tcp://host:port` (for a socket proxy). Default `unix:///var/run/docker.sock`. |

### `[local_webhooks]`

A local listener for webhooks from services on this host. Omit to disable.

| Key | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `allow_non_loopback` | boolean | Allow a `bind` address other than loopback. Default false: services on this host reach the relay, and nothing else does. |
| `bind` | string | Listen address. Default `127.0.0.1:7422`. |
| `token` | secret | A bearer token callers must send. Optional. |

### `[policy]`

What skills this agent is willing to run.

| Key | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `allow_risk` | list of `"read"` or `"write"` or `"destructive"` | Risk classes of skills this agent runs. Default `["read", "write"]`; add `"destructive"` to opt in. |
